claim: In the feature availability by resource table, Amazon Aurora has check marks for cross-Region backup, cross-account backup, AWS Backup Audit Manager, incremental backup, continuous backup and point-in-time restore, restore testing and logically air-gapped vault, and no check mark for full management, lifecycle to cold storage, item-level restore, backup search, backup tiering, malware protection or access points.
question: Which AWS Backup features does Amazon Aurora support, including continuous backup and cold storage?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon Aurora in the feature availability by resource table
qualifiers.condition: a blank cell means no check mark in the table
